findings.quote: Bluevine row: "Plus and Premier plans offer up to 3.3% APY (monthly subscription fees not published)"; Bluevine section: "monthly prices for Plus and Premier are not published"; change-our-answer bullet "Bluevine and Lili publishing standard monthly prices for their Plus, Premier..."; Bluevine section verdict line "undisclosed paid tiers"
findings.problem: Bluevine publishes these on https://www.bluevine.com/business-checking: Standard $0 (1.3% APY up to $250K with activity goal), Plus $30/month (1.75% APY up to $250K, no requirements), Premier $95/month (3.3% APY on all balances). The page states the fees are unpublished and says Plus reaches 3.3%.
findings.fix: Replace with the published figures in the row, the Bluevine section, the How to Choose paragraph and the change-our-answer bullet; remove 'undisclosed paid tiers'; keep Lili as the only tier-price-unpublished vendor.

findings.quote: Lili section: "a business holding $25,000 in savings on Lili at a 4.00% variable APY earns $1,000 per year"; row: "Savings up to 4.00% variable APY"; bestFit "high variable savings interest"; How to Choose: "Lili offers variable savings yields up to 4.00% APY"
findings.problem: Lili's own disclosure (lili.co footer) says 2.25% APY applies to balances up to $500,000 and 4.00% only to balances from $500,000 to $1,000,000. The worked example is wrong: $25,000 earns about $562.50 at 2.25%, not $1,000.
findings.fix: State 2.25% up to $500,000 and 4.00% from $500,000 to $1,000,000 (effective January 13, 2026, variable), and recompute the example ($25,000 x 2.25% = $562.50); fix the row, bestFit, How to Choose and Lili section.
